title: 第373章 正史观影如懿传有难题看我手动解决9第372章 正史观影如懿传有难题看我手动解决8
content_zh:
【逍遥王弘皙：康熙七十六年，我从理郡王变成了逍遥王，而我恨了半辈子的老仇人入土了，九泉之下，他若能安安稳稳，那我爱新觉罗弘皙愿永不入轮回，有我在一日，必然他身败名裂，遭世人唾弃！！！】
？？？！！！
看着上面满身戾气的人，所有人都愣住了。
他们对身后事极其重视，弘皙阿哥以‘转世轮回’来诅咒，这个仇人到底是谁啊？
想到这，众人暗戳戳的看向自己的怀疑对象，雍正、不，是雍亲王胤禛。
不同于这些人的反应，太子只觉得眼眶发酸。
弘皙虽是次子，但却是他实际意义上的长子，他精心养育，细心呵护他长大，为何他会变成如今这副模样，日后到底发生了什么？他不该是这样的啊！
“老四，你最好祈祷自己没做什么，不然孤一定要你的命，来给弘皙报仇！”
看着太子的表情，胤禛只觉得后背发凉，您说话就说话，能不能把手里的鞭子放下？
【逍遥王弘皙：说到这，我就必须要感谢一个人，那就是绿亲王胤禛，要不是他将起居注删了个七七八八，我怎么会有发挥的空间？】
！！！
“咳咳、咳咳。”
听着耳边此起彼伏的咳嗽声，再看看众人颤抖的肩膀，胤禛的脸都气青紫了。
别以为他不知道，这些人全都在心里狂笑呢。
朝臣们只敢在心里嘲笑，但胤禟可不会，于是看着眼前铁青的脸，故作不解的问道：“老四，你说这‘绿亲王’该不会是绿帽子的绿吧？”
“啧啧，九哥，我怎么觉得这封号不好啊？乌亲王才配得上老四，生母乌雅氏族，脸长得乌漆嘛黑、又是乌龟属性，这乌亲王多合适啊？”
“有道理啊，不过龟亲王也行，反正都一样。”
胤禛刚想反唇相讥，但还没开口，耳边就传来了老爷子的暴怒声。
“孽障，都给朕闭嘴，朕总算知道是谁编的起居注了，老四、弘皙，你们好的很啊？一个删除，一个自我发挥，你们这么厉害，怎么不上天呢？”
太子见状，直接将儿子护在身后，回怼道：“有因才有果，老四不删起居注，弘皙怎么会自我发挥，眼睛脑子不好就找太医。连罪魁祸首是谁你都看不出来，活着干嘛？”

太医们：......
太子爷，您看我们敢给皇上看吗？
“孽障，你们这群孽障，朕......”
阿哥们：呵呵，又是被老爷子迁怒的一天，习惯了，我们已经习惯了。
【逍遥王弘皙：不过绿亲王，为了感谢你的付出，我特意将你的排名降低了一点，让你成为我复仇榜上的第二人，你高兴吗？】
！！！
绿亲王、不，雍亲王是弘皙阿哥复仇榜上的第二人，那第一人是谁？
是太子的老对头大千岁，还是满朝赞誉的八阿哥，亦或者是九爷、十爷？
“看什么看？老子那是正大光明的争，总比那些挖别人墙角的好。”
老八胤禩：......
不就是挖你点墙角，至于这么斤斤计较吗？
“你把本王的身后名毁了，这是对我的感谢吗？还我高兴，高兴你个头啊！”
听到这话，太子直接一鞭子抽了过去，警告道：“老四，只要孤还是太子，弘皙他们对你罚也是赏，打也是奖，你只能老老实实受着，要是再让我从你的眼中，嘴里发现什么，你就等死吧。”
content_en:
[Xiaoyao Wang Hongxi: In the seventy-sixth year of Kangxi, I changed from Lijun Wang to Xiaoyao King, and the old enemy I hated for half my life has died. If he can be safe and sound under the Nine Springs, then I love Xinjieluo Hongxi and wish to never enter reincarnation. As long as I am around, he will definitely be ruined and cast aside by the world! ! ! 】
? ? ? ! ! !
Looking at the angry people above, everyone was stunned.
They attach great importance to the affairs after their death. Brother Hongxi cursed him with the word "reincarnation". Who is this enemy?
Thinking of this, everyone secretly looked at their suspect, Yong Zheng, no, it was Prince Yong Yinzhen.
Different from the reactions of these people, the prince only felt his eyes sore.
Although Hongxi is the second son, he is actually his eldest son. He raised him carefully and cared for him as he grew up. Why did he become like this? What happened in the future? He shouldn't be like this!
"Fourth child, you'd better pray that you didn't do anything, otherwise I will take your life to avenge Hong Xi!"
Looking at the prince's expression, Yinzhen felt a chill on his back. Just say what you say. Can you put down the whip in your hand?
[Xiaoyao Wang Hongxi: Speaking of which, I have to thank one person, and that is the Green Prince Yinzhen. If he hadn't deleted all the daily notes, how could I have room to perform? 】
! ! !
"Ahem, cough."
Listening to the coughing in his ears and looking at everyone's trembling shoulders, Yinzhen's face turned purple with anger.
Don't think he doesn't know, these people are all laughing in their hearts.
The courtiers only dared to laugh in their hearts, but Yinzhen would not do it, so he looked at the livid face in front of him and asked pretending to be puzzled: "Fourth, do you think this 'Green Prince' is a cuckold?"
"Tsk, tsk, Ninth Brother, why do I think this title is not good? Prince Wu is worthy of being the fourth child. His biological mother is from the Wuya clan. Her face is pitch black and she has the attributes of a tortoise. How suitable is Prince Wu?"
"It makes sense, but Prince Turtle is fine too, it's the same anyway."
Yinzhen was about to retort, but before he could speak, the old man's angry voice could be heard in his ears.
"Shut up, you bastards. I finally know who made up the daily notes. Lao Si and Hong Xi, how good are you? One deletes, the other expresses oneself. You are so awesome, why don't you go to heaven?"
Seeing this, the prince directly protected his son behind him and replied: "There is a cause and an effect. If the fourth child doesn't delete his daily notes, how can Hongxi show his self-discipline? If his eyes and brain are not good, he should go to the imperial doctor. You can't even tell who the culprit is, so what are you doing living?"
Doctors:...
Prince, do you think we dare to show it to the emperor?
"Nons, you guys, I..."
Brother: Haha, it’s another day when the old man gets angry. We are used to it. We are used to it.
[Xiaoyao Wang Hongxi: But Prince Green, in order to thank you for your efforts, I deliberately lowered your ranking and made you the second person on my revenge list. Are you happy? 】
! ! !
Prince Green, no, Prince Yong is the second person on Brother Hongxi’s revenge list, so who is the first person?
Is it the prince's old enemy Da Qiansui, the eighth prince praised by the whole court, or the ninth and tenth masters?
"What are you looking at? It's an honest and open fight, it's better than those who poach others."
Lao Ba Yinhu:......
Isn't it just poaching you, why are you so fussy about it?
"You ruined my king's posthumous reputation. Is this a thank you to me? I'm happy for you. I'm so happy for you!"
Hearing this, the prince whipped him directly and warned: "Fourth brother, as long as Gu is still the prince, Hongxi and the others will punish you and reward you, and spankings will also be rewards. You can only endure it honestly. If I find anything from your eyes or mouth again, you will die."
